The Gunner carries two rounds of each of three types of shot into any game.

Sniper round: range 42", Strength 4. It adds 1 to injury rolls, and all shots are at an extra -1 save. It may be used with the scope.
Man stopper: range 18", Strength 3. If it hits, roll a D6: on a 4+ the target is automatically stunned. It may be used with the scope.
Poison gas spray: range 24", no Strength. Anyone hit must take a Toughness test at -1; anyone else within 2" is also hit on a 4+ and must take a Toughness test with no penalty. A failed test costs the victim one wound, with no save.

specials.name: Highly Unstable
specials.description:
The Jezzail Cannon uses this misfire chart on any natural roll of 1 to hit.

D6 | Effect
1 | Getitoffme! The jezzail is about to blow and is fused to the Gunner. In each movement phase he runs 2D6" in a random direction, which will never bring him into base contact and always leaves him 1" away. If charged, he automatically escapes from combat in your next movement phase. At the end of each of your movement phases roll a D6: on a 5+ the jezzail explodes, killing the Gunner at once and dealing a S4 hit to every model within 3".
2 | Own Medicine. The Gunner is hit by a blast of whatever he was firing, and the gun may not be used for the rest of the game.
3 | Oops. The Gunner loses balance and spins round before firing. Roll a random direction from his position: the shot hits the first solid object in its path. The hit is automatic, but may be dodged by normal means. This uses up one round of ammunition.
4-5 | Click-Click-Click. The weapon does not ignite. It may be fired as normal next round, and the shot is not wasted.
6 | Mwah Ha Ha! The shot hits its target at +1 Strength. With the poison gas, its range is extended by a further 2".

hired_sword.unique_to: Skaven, Undead, Chaos and Dark Elf warbands may hire a Jezzail Gunner.

specials.name: Harpoon
specials.description: The Leviathan Hunter's harpoon counts as a javelin.

specials.name: Skinner
specials.description: The Hunter may wield a spear and a sword at the same time.

specials.name: Get Over 'Ere!
specials.description: Before throwing his harpoon the Hunter may try to pull the target closer. If the thrown spear hits, the target rolls a D6 and adds its Strength, and the Hunter rolls a D6 and adds his. The loser is moved towards the winner, in a straight line, as many inches as the difference between the two results; a tie moves neither. If the model being pulled reaches base contact with the winner, it counts as the winner charging the loser, even though the winner did not move. A model pulled this way may leave combat, and the models it was fighting do not get to attack it as it leaves. The Hunter may not throw his harpoon while he is engaged in combat. A large or mounted model adds 1 to its dice roll. If the target is pulled off a ledge it drops instead of being pulled the whole distance, and may try to jump down if the height is 6" or less.

hired_sword.unique_to: Any warband except Undead and Skaven may hire a Leviathan Hunter.

available_special_skills.name: Reel In
available_special_skills.description: The Leviathan Hunter adds 2 to all Get Over 'Ere! rolls, or 3 if he has the Mighty Blow skill.

available_special_skills.name: Lady Luck
available_special_skills.description: After any game in which the Hunter was not taken out of action, choose a hero and one of these items: a rabbit's foot on a 2+, a lucky charm on a 2+ or a whalebone charm on a 3+. Roll a D6: on a success that hero gains the item, which may never be resold. On a failure that hero rolls two dice for his first dice roll next game and takes the worse of the two. The Hunter may make luck items for himself instead, but takes them with him if he ever leaves the warband.

name: Swivel Gunner
description: His profile is already reduced by the swivel gun: without it he is M4 I3, and with it M3 I2.

specials.name: Swivel Gun
specials.description: The Swivel Gunner uses the swivel gun's rules from the Pirate warband section.

specials.name: There Can Be Only One
specials.description: A warband may only ever have one swivel gun, hired or permanent. This does not count scenarios that give it extra swivel guns for a battle.

specials.name: Limited Load
specials.description: A Swivel Gunner carries only two of each type of ammunition into each battle.

specials.name: Homebound
specials.description: He is only found in the Sartosa campaign setting.

hired_sword.unique_to: Any warband except Skaven, Undead, Chaos and Dark Elf may hire a Swivel Gunner.

name: Old Smuggler
description: Also wears a great coat. His Movement is 4 without his peg leg and 3 with it.

specials.name: Peg Leg
specials.description: The Old Smuggler's peg leg costs him 1 Movement and gives him a 6+ ward save.

specials.name: Peek
specials.description: Once per exploration phase, when opening crates, the warband may re-roll the D66 for the crate's contents. The second result must be taken.

specials.name: Auctioneer
specials.description: Once per post-game the warband may discard one cargo for the Smuggler to auction off. Choose any number of D6 from 1 to 6 and roll them. If none comes up a 1, the warband gains that many gold crowns. If any comes up a 1, the authorities confiscate the cargo and the warband gains nothing. None of these dice may be re-rolled.

hired_sword.unique_to: Any warband except Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar and the Lothern Sea Patrol may hire an Old Smuggler.

available_special_skills.name: Black Market (Old Smuggler)
available_special_skills.description: Once per post-game the warband may choose any item it could normally buy and pay half its price. The Old Smuggler takes a Leadership test: if he passes, the item is bought. Otherwise the authorities confiscate the money and he misses a number of games equal to the item's rarity minus 8. His upkeep is still paid.

available_special_skills.name: Guardian (Old Smuggler)
available_special_skills.description: The Smuggler has acquired a bodyguard. The bodyguard only protects the Smuggler and cannot fulfil warband objectives, search, loot or do anything other than protect him, so he stays within 1" of the Smuggler at all times. He gains no experience and is not paid. If the Smuggler is caught while using the Black Market skill, the bodyguard is not fielded until he returns. Bodyguard profile: M4 WS4 BS2 S4 T3 W1 I3 A1 Ld8, with a sword, light armour, a shield and a helmet. He will intercept any model shooting at or charging the man he guards: those attacks are directed at him, and if the man is charged, place the bodyguard in front of him. The bodyguard will not charge unless the man he guards charges, and cannot intercept an attack while already engaged in combat.

specials.name: Hired in a Pair
specials.description: An Orc Pirate and a Goblin Swabbie must be hired at the same time.

specials.name: Booma Pistol
specials.description: The Booma Pistol works exactly like a normal pistol, except that it has Strength 5. It also misfires on a natural 1 when rolling to hit and when rolling to wound.

specials.name: 'Spendible
specials.description: The Orc Pirate has no problem shooting into a combat that involves only his Swabbie and enemy models. The shots are distributed at random.

specials.name: 'Nessa-s'ry
specials.description: If the Swabbie dies in the post-game, the warband must buy a replacement Swabbie or the Orc Pirate will refuse to fight. There is no need to roll to find the replacement: one is found automatically.

hired_sword.unique_to: Any Orc, Goblin or Ogre warband may hire an Orc Pirate. He must be hired at the same time as a Goblin Swabbie.

available_special_skills.name: Booma Builda
available_special_skills.description: The Orc Pirate may at once build himself a second Booma pistol. If a Booma pistol is stolen or explodes he may replace it the next game for free. He may only carry or own two Booma pistols at a time, may not give one to another warrior and may not sell one.

specials.name: Hired in a Pair
specials.description: An Orc Pirate and a Goblin Swabbie must be hired at the same time.

specials.name: 'Spendible
specials.description: The Orc Pirate has no problem shooting into a combat that involves only his Swabbie and enemy models. The shots are distributed at random.

hired_sword.unique_to: Any Orc, Goblin or Ogre warband may hire a Goblin Swabbie. He must be hired at the same time as an Orc Pirate.

available_special_skills.name: Pin Thrower
available_special_skills.description: The Goblin may throw three belaying pins in a single shooting phase, so long as he has not moved. He may target several models. This may not be used with Quick Shot.
